packageRules.description: Antora and Asciidoctor are pinned by ADR-0002: @springio/asciidoctor-extensions uses the Opal API that @asciidoctor/core 4.x drops, and Antora 3.2 pins the same range. An upgrade is a conversion change, not a dependency bump — it needs a full reconversion and a diff review.
Dev tooling moves together; one PR rather than five.
